commits.message:
Split dotnet-port nightly workflow into API and fixes agents (#358)

Replace dotnet-port-nightly with two scoped nightly porting agents:

- dotnet-port-api-nightly ([dotnet-port-api]): new or changed public API and feature parity (may add surface).

- dotnet-port-fixes-nightly ([dotnet-port-fixes]): bug fixes, behavior alignment, and tests with no public API changes.

Each carries a symmetric exported-symbol litmus test so every candidate routes to exactly one workflow. Lock files compiled with gh aw v0.79.8; actions-lock.json adds the actions/github-script v9.0.0 pin the new locks require.

commits.message:
Reduce dotnet-port API/fixes overlap and skip weekends (#389)

* Reduce dotnet-port API/fixes overlap and skip weekends

- Restrict both nightly porting workflows to weekdays (Mon-Fri) so results do not pile up over the weekend; cron 19 5 * * 1-5 (api) and 22 2 * * 1-5 (fixes), preserving the prior scattered times.

- Strengthen cross-workflow de-duplication: search existing issues AND pull requests (open and recently closed) from both prefixes, dedup by upstream commit/.NET PR/Go area, and cover the Go-misalignment fallback. These read-only workflows report results as prefixed tracking issues that link the proposed PR, so issues must be searched.

- Clarify the test-ownership boundary so tests accompanying an upstream public-API change are ported only by [dotnet-port-api], not separately by [dotnet-port-fixes].

* Restore Dependabot action pins in recompiled lock files

The v0.79.8 recompile reverted Dependabot's in-place pin bumps. Re-apply them so the executed actions match the repo standard: actions/checkout v7.0.0 (#337) and github/gh-aw-actions/setup v0.81.6 (#386). gh-aw-manifest left at its pre-bump SHAs to match the other workflow lock files on main. Compiler version unchanged (v0.79.8).

commits.message:
ci(workflows): fix firewall awmg-mcpg denial + bump gh-aw to v0.83.4 (#762)

* ci(workflows): fix firewall awmg-mcpg denial + bump gh-aw to v0.83.4

Work around github/gh-aw#45915 in go-api-consistency-review: the Copilot
engine's native HTTP MCP transport calls the internal awmg-mcpg gateway
(http://awmg-mcpg:8080/mcp/...), which the firewall's Squid proxy denies
(TCP_DENIED/403). The block report then recommends adding "awmgmcpg" to
network.allowed, but that single-label host is neither a valid ecosystem
identifier nor an FQDN, so `gh aw compile` rejects it.

Route GitHub tools (github.mode: gh-proxy) and Safe Outputs (tools.cli-proxy:
true) through the CLI proxy instead of the native HTTP MCP endpoints, which
removes all traffic to awmg-mcpg and eliminates the denial and the bogus
recommendation. Revert network back to `defaults`.

Also includes `gh aw upgrade` output: bump setup-cli/version to v0.83.4,
refresh actions-lock.json and skill/agent docs, and recompile the dotnet-*
nightly and go-api-consistency-review lock files.

* cleanup
